programme.title: A Ellas Les Gustan Mayores
programme.desc: Ricardo Soto está casado con Miranda Robles, una mujer guapa con una afortunada posición social. Su esposo aprovechará esta situación para ponerle el cuerno con una jovencita mucho menor que él, sin recordar que el que ríe al último, ríe mejor.

programme.title: Angela
programme.desc: Ángela es una reconocida agente judicial porque tiene la destreza de encontrar a los criminales más buscados, pero su peor enemigo es su pasado. Luchará con todas sus fuerzas para encontrar a su madre.

programme.title: Autodefensas
programme.desc: Dos hermanos gemelos entran en disputa cuando Juan "El Puma" secuestra al hijo de su hermano Manuel a cambio de quedarse con su propiedad más valiosa, la tierra de "El Paraíso". Mientras, Manuel se unirá al grupo de lucha Autodefensas para hacer justicia por sus propias manos.

programme.title: Salsa Tel Aviv
programme.desc: Vicky viaja a Israel disfrazada de monja para reencontrarse con su marido, quien trabaja ilegalmente en Tel Aviv como maestro de salsa, en el camino se encuentra con Yoni, un tímido profesor quien le ayuda a pasar la aduana en Israel.

programme.title: Por amor al money
programme.desc: Dos días antes de su boda, Santiago, un encantador gerente de hotel, es cautivado por Dolores, una mujer sexi y misteriosa. Cuando es descubierto siendo infiel, la boda se cancela y Santiago pierde su trabajo, su casa y su reputación al ser acusado de traficar con drogas. Arruinado, Santiago decide buscar la ayuda de Dolores, sólo para descubrir que todo es parte de un plan diseñado por un antiguo enemigo.

programme.title: Rápidas y valientes
programme.desc: Las hermanas Madrigal, dos mujeres de la droga, buscarán vengarse de las personas que asesinaron a su padre y a su hermano. El comandante, Joaquín Mayoral, está involucrado en esas muertes. A las Madrigal y al comandante los une un gran secreto.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving in beautiful Mauritius Brent has his first taste of their curry. The Indian population has had a huge influence on the cuisine, but Mauritian curries are unique. Brent meets with Chef Vance to learn the distinctly Mauritian secrets to making curry as he's never made it before. Inspired by his previous trip to South Africa and the distinct textures and tastes of the Mauritian curry he decides to try his own hand at a fusion bunny chow. Heading into the local markets he overcomes language barriers as he struggles to source the ingredients. Finally, baguette in hand, he heads of to the famous colonial house, turned museum, Chateau De LaBourdonnais, where he cooks up at curry amazing feast under the tropical sun and mango trees.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with some adrenaline pumping sea karting on the West Coast of the Island. He then heads to the home of Manuella to have an Otentik Creole experience with her and her family. A mix of African and European cuisines influenced by Asia, Creole cuisine is a delicious, colorful melting pot of flavours and Manuella teaches Brent just how to blend these notes to create a unique dish. Tasty creole food and too much rum later Brent is having a ball. The next morning Brent hits the markets to get his ingredients for his creole inspired dish. Heading back to the Ravenala hotel he has a refresher before cooking up his own creole creation on the Riviera Riverside.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritius is a multi-ethnic, multilingual and multicultural society. After chatting to his guide, Denis, about his Indian heritage Brent is curious to get to know more about the unique Hindu culture of Mauritius. Travelling deep into the heart of the island he heads to Ganga Talao, a sacred crater lake situated in a secluded mountain area where a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva brings in hundreds of pilgrims every day. There he meets with Priest Dayal who takes him on a tour of Hindu culture and beliefs, opening Brent's eyes to a fascinating part of this multifaceted island. Being ever the adrenalin junky, Brent isn't willing to let the rain put a dampener on his planned quad biking safari. Speeding through the pouring rain, Brent heads to the top of a mountain in the Domaine De L'Etoile Réserve, in hopes of catching a glimpse of the fabled view. He then returns to his apartment and is warmed up by some tasty fusion Indian cooking using the Mauritian staple, Okra.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: The French are famous for their haute cuisine with its extravagant presentations and complex techniques. After swimming with wild dolphins Brent meets with Michael Scioli, head chef at the prestigious hotel, Le Constance Prince Maurice on the east coast of the Island. Chef Michael shows him how to prepare a specialized French seafood dish using ingredients straight from the hotel's garden. Seeing as you can never have too much adventure, Brent then tries out fly and dive boarding (mainly dive) which is essentially a water powered jet pack. After an afternoon of fun, he limps into the hotel veggie garden to pick some ingredients for his own feast of French fusion prawns and coconut heart salad as the sun sets on anther beautiful day in paradise.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with an undersea walk before heading to Port Louis to meet Lloyd in Chinatown. A massive archway welcomes him onto the busy Chinatown streets and Brent and Lloyd whet their appetites with some Chinese street food. The Chinese influence on Mauritian food has been huge and there have been more than a few fusion dishes to come out of their Chinatown. Brent and Lloyd head to a local Chinese restaurant to try a popular dish that is unique to Mauritius, a Bol Renverse, an "upside-down bowl". After a delicious lunch Lloyd has a treat planned for Brent. He takes him to the Kwan Tee Pagoda, the oldest Pagoda in Mauritius and believed to be the oldest in the Southern Hemisphere. After a magical day Brent head's back to his hotel inspired and ready to cook up a storm. The next day Brent goes in search of ingredients in a local Chinese supermarket and then heads to a peaceful garden to cook his mustard pork with a twist.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Sugar is commonly known on the island as the Mauritian Miracle, having once been the backbone of Mauritius's economy. Brent visits L'Adventure du Sucre museum and gets a fascinating look at how the Mauritian history is tightly intertwined with sugar. He then heads in to the fields to for some fun cutting cane before meeting up with Chef Oliver and who shows Brent just how much Mauritians love sugar and spice. Brent then heads out to the stunning and exclusive island, Ile Des Deux Cocos, for some snorkeling in a marine sanctuary and then cooks up his own Mauritian tropical desert on a remote coral beach.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving at the stunning resort of LUX* Belle Mare, Brent is amazed by their stylish, contemporary spin on luxury hospitality. Surrounded by tropical gardens and pristine white beaches, this is what everyone imagines Mauritius to be and more. He meets up with Chef Nicolas where they cook up a seafood specialty which they then enjoy under the sun on the beach. With a reef nearby, Brent rents a glass bottomed kayak and paddles out to check out the sea life. Then hopping on a bicycle, he rides to a nearby market to get the ingredients he needs for his take on a Chef Nicolas's dish, Mauritian lobster rolls, which he prepares under shady palms.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritius is covered in sugar cane plantations and Mauritian rum is growing fast on the international market. Brent heads to St Aubin, an estate with one of the oldest sugar cane fields and a factory that produces both artisanal and traditional rums. There he not only tastes the rum but learns all about making it too. It's a good thing he has nothing else planned that day. The next morning Brent visits a nearby market to buy his ingredients and then gets his adrenaline pumping with a wild tubing experience where he learns just how solid water is, again and again, and again. He then heads off on a sunset catamaran cruise where he cooks up a delicious caramel, rum, jerked chicken dish, finishing off the day with a rum cocktail. Is it the waves making him unsteady on his feet or all the rum?

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritians have a passion for tea. Their esteem and adoration almost match that of the British. Vanilla tea in particular, is a staple in Mauritian house-holds. Brent begins his journey into the history of this grand love affair at Bois Cheri Tea Factory, home to some of the oldest tea fields on the island. After learning how tea goes from a leafy bush to a brew-able bag he gets to experience the various flavours at a tea tasting with a view. Brent then meets up with a Mauritian local, Aurelie, at Flaq market to buy ingredients for a tea dish she is going to teach him. It's a beautiful day and, regardless of his fear of heights, Brent decides to fit in some parasailing before the cook. He then heads to Cap Malheureux where he and Aurelie cook her mother's tea chicken dish.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent looks back on his time in Mauritius. Everything he's learnt, the laughs, the people, the food. Co-existence amongst the Indian, African, European and Chinese locals has led to a sharing of cultures and values, giving the Mauritians a great sense of national pride and Brent can feel it. An island commonly associated with coconuts and cocktails is proven to be so much deeper and after being welcomed into homes, sacred places of worship and given family cooking secrets, Brent is left feeling like he is part of the Mauritian family.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this episode, Sandra McLemore invites you to experience Austria like never before—through its royal palaces, charming villages, and centuries-old traditions. Wander through Schönbrunn Palace after hours, uncovering secret passageways, regal ballrooms, and stories of Empress Sisi. Then, watch a master pastry chef craft the perfect apple strudel—Vienna’s most iconic dessert. The journey continues to Dürnstein, a fairytale village in the Wachau Valley, where apricot orchards, wine, and UNESCO charm steal the spotlight. And in Hallstatt, go underground for an epic adventure through the world’s oldest working salt mine—slides, miner’s gear, and all. Along the way, Sandra shares must-know travel tips for making the most of your Austrian escape. From imperial elegance to alpine thrills, this episode blends history, culture, and flavor into one unforgettable journey.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the premiere of It's A Beautiful World, Jeff Fuchs joins a team of doctors as they navigate the vast waterways of the Amazon River to deliver vital healthcare to remote Indigenous communities. Set in the tri-border region between Colombia, Brazil, and Peru, this episode offers a powerful look at medicine, resilience, and human connection in one of the most isolated places on Earth.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Jeff ventures deep into the Amazon rainforest to explore a secluded eco-lodge committed to sustainable living. He visits a monkey sanctuary working to rehabilitate rescued wildlife and ends the day by joining locals in a spirited community soccer tournament—celebrating the role of sport, conservation, and joy in jungle life.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Two years after his first Amazon expedition, Jeff Fuchs is invited back by his friend Juan Alan Muñoz for an extraordinary journey into one of the most remote and untouched parts of the rainforest. After arriving by cargo plane in the outpost of La Chorrera, Jeff boards Juan’s newly outfitted hospital boat—but before the journey can begin, he is summoned to meet the regional Chief of the Igara Paraná. In a powerful exchange of trust and tradition, Jeff offers gifts of maple syrup and receives the Chief’s blessing to travel the sacred waterways.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: With the Chief’s blessing—and a gesture of goodwill in the form of Canadian maple syrup—Jeff is invited to spend a day immersed in the region’s haunting past. Guided by the Chief, he visits rubber trees still standing as silent witnesses to the atrocities of the 1920s Amazon rubber boom, where the Chief’s own grandparents were slaughtered. The journey leads to the ruins of the Arana Brothers’ former headquarters, a chilling site of colonial exploitation, brutality, and genocide. In this moving episode, history, memory, and reconciliation converge deep in the jungle.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Before departing La Chorrera, Jeff takes time to explore Juan Alan Muñoz’s remarkable floating hospital—a lifeline for remote Amazonian communities. Onboard, Jeff witnesses eye surgeries, dental procedures, and vital health and nutrition services being delivered to those with no other access to medical care. As the boat prepares for its 400-mile journey, this episode offers an inspiring look at grassroots healthcare in one of the most inaccessible regions on Earth.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: As the floating hospital leaves La Chorrera, Jeff arrives in the village of Providencia—home to the Bora people, whose culture is deeply tied to the sacred triad of coca, tobacco, and cassava. Unexpectedly, Jeff stumbles upon a rare and powerful event: a regional summit where Indigenous chiefs from across the Amazon have gathered to discuss peace, territory, and cultural preservation—an event many call the “G7 of the Amazon.” Following tradition, Jeff must await an invitation to meet the local chief. While respectfully waiting, he spends a day with a local fisherman, navigating the winding rivers and gaining insight into traditional fishing practices passed down through generations.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Jeff is finally summoned to the Maloka—the ceremonial longhouse—by the Chief of the Bora people. In a moment of deep cultural significance, the Chief offers his blessing and invites Jeff to witness a traditional gathering of the entire village and visiting Amazonian leaders. As sacred dances unfold in rhythmic celebration, the air is filled with the earthy scent of Mambe being prepared—coca leaves ground and mixed in an ancestral ritual that binds community, history, and spirit. It's a rare and intimate glimpse into the heart of Indigenous ceremony in the Amazon.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Throughout the journey, one sacred element has remained constant—Mambe, a traditional preparation of coca leaf that lies at the heart of Indigenous Amazonian life. In this episode, Jeff meets “Happy,” a spirited local who guides him through the complete Mambe-making process, from leaf to ritual. Through the voices of elders and community members, the episode explores the cultural, spiritual, and communal importance of Mambe—revealing its role not just as a sacred tradition, but as a living symbol of identity, respect, and connection to the land.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: As Jeff’s journey along the Igara Paraná draws to a close, the hospital boat enters the Putumayo River—edging ever closer to the self-isolated Pupuna tribe. The first stop along this new stretch is Puerto Arica, a lively river town hosting an international soccer tournament that brings together traders, travelers, and communities from across the Amazon. Amid the weekend of celebration, Jeff is invited on a night-time caiman hunt beneath a moonlit sky, and joins a local tradesman for an early morning fishing trip followed by a rustic riverside breakfast. It’s a brief but colorful pause before the journey continues deeper into isolation.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: While anchored for an overnight stay along the Putumayo River, Jeff and the crew are approached by a group of Israelites—members of a little-known, non-Indigenous community that has settled deep in the Amazon to prepare for a prophesied seven-year drought. What begins as a surreal encounter takes an unexpected turn when the group requests medical help for the ailing grandson of their community leader. This urgent plea grants Jeff and the team unprecedented access to a secretive world rarely seen by outsiders—revealing a unique blend of spiritual belief, isolation, and survivalist purpose hidden deep within the jungle.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: After weeks navigating remote rivers, dense jungle, and unexpected encounters, Jeff and the floating hospital team finally reach their most distant and mysterious destination: the territory of the self-isolated Pupuna. What follows is a delicate and respectful moment of contact, made possible only through trust built over years and the careful guidance of local leaders. With no cameras allowed beyond a certain point, Jeff experiences a rare glimpse into a community untouched by modern influence—where ancient ways of life endure in harmony with the forest. It is a quiet, humbling encounter that marks the emotional peak of the Amazon journey.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the season finale of It’s a Beautiful World, Jeff looks back on the unforgettable meals and spontaneous encounters and places that shaped his journey through the Amazon. This episode captures the emotional heart of the expedition.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Jeff is finally summoned to the Maloka—the ceremonial longhouse—by the Chief of the Bora people. In a moment of deep cultural significance, the Chief offers his blessing and invites Jeff to witness a traditional gathering of the entire village and visiting Amazonian leaders. As sacred dances unfold in rhythmic celebration, the air is filled with the earthy scent of Mambe being prepared—coca leaves ground and mixed in an ancestral ritual that binds community, history, and spirit. It's a rare and intimate glimpse into the heart of Indigenous ceremony in the Amazon.

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this episode of Authentic Escapes, Sandra McLemore takes families on a journey where history and adventure come together in unforgettable ways. From navigating the hedge maze at Vienna’s Schönbrunn Palace—once a playground for royalty—to wandering the lavish halls of Cairo’s Abdeen Palace, this trip is anything but ordinary. In Aswan, families pause for an elegant high tea at the Old Cataract Hotel, the very place where Agatha Christie wrote Death on the Nile. It’s a moment of calm and connection, with sweeping Nile views and Egyptian charm. The journey wraps in Prague, where a vintage Alfa Romeo transforms a sightseeing tour into a glamorous ride through history. More than just sightseeing, Family Travel celebrates curiosity, culture, and time spent together. Whether you're sipping tea or solving a maze, these experiences spark conversations—and memories—that last long after the trip is over.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger visits Hot Springs, Arkansas for the annual RUNNING OF THE TUBS – to watch costumed teams race bathtubs filled with water through the downtown; stops in for an historic scrub down & steam at the BUCKSTAFF BATH HOUSE; takes in an astounding collection of 3D advertising art at the POLLACK MUSEUM in AZ; and then attempts to pick the right square at CHICKEN POOP BINGO in Austin, TX.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger drives the Illinois leg of historic ROUTE 66 to find: the birthplace of the COZY DOG in Springfield; a city hall with a phone booth on its roof in LINCOLN; the land-yacht of itinerant Route 66 artist Bob Waldmire in PONTIAC; a roadside attraction called HENRY’S RABBIT RANCH; and then rides along at the annual bike race/eating contest known as the TOUR DE DONUT in Staunton.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: In Chicago, host Will Clinger attends the parody of the IDITAROD - the CHI-DITAROD, where the sled is a shopping cart pulled by people instead of dogs; checks in to the Watergate Hotel’s SCANDAL ROOM in DC; visits the studio of surrealist MICHAEL P PRICE in Arizona; squeezes himself into a DWARF CAR for a drive in Maricopa; and then marvels at an art exhibit made entirely out of PEEPS in Wisconsin.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger visits McMinnville, Oregon’s UFO FEST to witness the extraterrestrial parade & alien pet contest; examines the MUSEUM OF MENTAL HEALTH in Salem where One Flew Over The Cuckoo’s Nest was filmed; tries not to crash in a jet simulator at the NAVAL FLIGHT ACADEMY in Pensacola; and then marvels at the huge model ships and animated “rock band” made completely out of…TOOTHPICKS!

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger journeys hundreds of feet underground to tour the historic QUEEN COPPER MINE in beautiful Bisbee, Arizona; spends the night at the nearby SHADY DELL retro trailer park; goes nowhere but up at an WHITE MOUNTAIN HOT AIR BALLOONFEST and then tries to dodge ferocious flying carp at the annual central Illinois REDNECK FISHING TOURNAMENT (spoiler alert: he fails).

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger delves into the paranormal legends surrounding EDGAR ALLAN POE and the USS CONSTELLATION in Baltimore; reaches for his wallet at America’s only PURSE MUSEUM in Little Rock; wanders among hundreds of critters at the MIDWEST FUR FEST in Chicago; and then tees off with Sister Cindy at an event called (no kidding) BEAT THE NUN.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger feels right at home in a roomful of dummies at the VENTRILOQUISTS’ CONVENTION in Kentucky; finds all things feline at the LUCKY CAT MUSEUM in Cincinnat; drives out to CARHENGE - Nebraska’s answer to Stonehenge; and then sees where the bodies are not buried but frozen (in liquid nitrogen) at ALCOR CRYOGENICS in Scottsdale – Open To The Public!

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger spends an entire episode chronicling the annual, KINETIC SCULPTURE RACE in Baltimore – an outrageously challenging competition among two dozen human-powered, amphibious, all-terrain mobile works of art slogging through a 15 mile course of city streets, mud, sand and Baltimore’s inner harbor. All entries are vying for the coveted GRAND MEDIOCRE CHAMPION award.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger attends the traveling ODDITIES and CURIOSITIES EXPO and encounters some truly bizarre and disturbing exhibits; samples the entertainment and menu at America's only VEGAN STRIP CLUB in Portland; takes in some target practice at MACHINE GUN AMERICA near Orlando; then ascends the UFO WATCHTOWER in Colorado to search the night sky for extraterrestrials.

programme.desc: An LA precinct is under siege by a bloodthirsty street gang.

programme.title: The Pledge

programme.desc: Randy is at the Raven working on some Big Tine clover maintenance and getting the plot he killed the Boss 8 in during rifle season ready to go. Tune in and get some tips for your clover plots and watch Randy take out the oldest deer on the Raven.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Contributor Josh Honeycutt breaks down the profound impact of hunting mentorship, exploring why it is equally vital to guide the next generation and to have a mentor of your own. The episode highlights the true reward of these bonds by showcasing a memorable hunt where Josh's guidance and mentorship make a massive, life-changing impact on a young hunter.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Daniel Schmidt and Zach Haas dive into the topic of Epizootic Hemorrhagic Disease (EHD), exploring what it is, how it spreads, and the impact it has on whitetail deer populations. Daniel then takes viewers back ten years to a memorable hunt in Kansas where he harvested a buck that had survived EHD. The remarkable deer carried lasting signs of its battle with the disease, including a severely deformed club foot believed to be the result of surviving the infection. This episode offers a fascinating look at deer resilience and provides hunters with a deeper understanding of one of the most significant diseases affecting whitetails today.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester team members and employees meet up at the Keefer Brothers property in Missouri for a multi day deer camp. Along for the ride are outdoor editors Scott Ergas and Dave Hurteau. Chris and Casey are on the search for some large bucks, as well as showing the people at the camp a great time and what deer season is all about.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: The Southards continue their family tradition on Table Rock Lake. While they’re there, Trenton spends a day with “Mr. Worldwide” James Watson and learns some things from one of the best anglers on the lake.

programme.title: The Cast

programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh

He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we’re experiencing it with one of the area’s most respected captains. Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys’ premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: In this episode, Rush welcomes Cullen Lundholm from Cape Cod to experience Key West at its finest. Over several action-packed days, they target a variety of species in the incredible waters surrounding the Florida Keys. But the adventure doesn’t end at the dock—Cullen also experiences Key West’s world-class accommodations, exceptional food, and one-of-a-kind island lifestyle. From unforgettable fishing to first-class hospitality, this episode shows why Key West and the Florida Keys are among the world’s premier fishing and vacation destinations.

programme.desc: For decades, Paul Butski has set the standard in turkey calling. His name is etched into the NWTF Grand National Calling Championships Hall of Fame, and his influence stretches far beyond the stage. He didn’t just win competitions, he shaped the way we talk to turkeys – and more importantly, the way we hunt them.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Todd Rogers embraces the business of being a hunting outfitter as a labor of love. And while so many family-run operations are dwindling in rural America, the Rogers legacy is here to stay. Will Cooper and Josh Dahlke return to western Oklahoma to share this story while pursuing brush-country whitetails in the red dirt.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: SoCal summer is calling, and the Local Knowledge crew is back on Ali’s home turf in San Diego, California. With reports of hot bites and fish moving in, the crew faces a classic Southern California dilemma — chase big yellowtail around the Coronado Islands or head north in search of bluefin tuna. The options are plenty, the challenges are real, and that’s exactly what keeps fishing in SoCal so exciting.

programme.title: The Direction
programme.desc: Mark is with guest and great friend Jimmy Jennings. Jimmy helped get The Direction, Marks dream of filming outdoor TV, to reality. His team at One Call Concepts supported Marks idea of delivering The Call 811, the national call before you dig number and safe digging message, to the outdoor viewer thru outdoor TV a reality. programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - Southern California Bluefin Tuna Fishing at Its Finest, Part Two
programme.desc: Today on Stoked On Fishing, we head offshore on the Stoked On Fishing Charters 35-foot Everglades with an All-Star crew searching for bluefin tuna. We take out Okuma Fishing Tackles President Doug and John, head of product development. We also have on board Colin and his wife, Amanda from Grundens, and our friend Toby from Mag Bay Lures and Mag Bay Resort down in Baja, Mexico. This trip was absolutely nuts, with the best Blue Fin Tuna fishing we have seen in Sothern California all year.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing — Fishing with Veterans on the El Dorado
programme.desc: There is no pill, no prescription, and no vaccination that can cure the effects of PTS better than connecting with fellow Veterans through shared experiences. Stoked On Fishing and Save The Brave to bring awareness to PTSD (Post Traumatic syndrome). In this special episode, we take a group of veterans fishing on the El Dorado out of Long Beach Sportfishing. We catch giant southern California White Sea Bass, Calico Bass, Sheep's Head, and Yellowtail.

Due to Covid 19, the sport boats have new guidelines to follow and only offer limited guests. This turns out to be a massive benefit to the passengers because they have more space for Fishing. On this adventure, we fish on the El Dorado for the first time since the pandemic began and have a blast.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - The Magdalena Bay Experience, Part Two
programme.desc: One of the best parts of traveling is the pleasant surprises that come along every trip. In last week's episode, Shea McIntee and the crew had a remarkable day of Marlin fishing in Madalena Bay. Now we find out Madalena Bay doesn't only have fantastic offshore fishing, it also has inshore fishing that is out of this world. Shea's captain takes us to some of his favorite spots to catch Red Snapper, Snook, Corbina, and a fish we have never seen before, Palometa.

programme.title: Refeições para Toda a Semana

programme.desc: Depois de uma primeira temporada bem servida de sucesso, o Chef Henrique Sá Pessoa leva-nos de novo a viajar pelos caminhos mais saborosos do nosso Portugal. É uma viagem gastronómica pelos 18 distritos do país, de norte a sul, com passagem pela Madeira e Açores.

programme.title: ComTradição
programme.desc: O aclamado chef Henrique Sá Pessoa faz uma reinterpretação da cozinha tradicional portuguesa numa viagem às raízes da gastronomia nacional onde pretende actualizar receitas e trazer a comfort food tradicional para os dias de hoje.

programme.title: ComTradição
programme.desc: Desta vez vamos até Braga, explorar a rica gastronomia nortenha desta zona. O Henrique irá começar por umas suculentas Frigideiras, depois um Bacalhau à Narcisa, e acabamos com o típico Leite de Creme.

programme.title: Sabores lá da Terra
programme.desc: É mais uma semana repleta de ação na pequena exploração agrícola de Julius Roberts, com resgate de abelhas, petiscos irresistíveis, sobremesas divinais e pizzas caseiras levadas a um novo patamar, com massa infalível e coberturas criativas.

programme.title: Sabores lá da Terra
programme.desc: O primeiro verão de Julius Roberts na sua pequena exploração agrícola em Dorset chega ao fim com um mergulho em busca de vieiras e um churrasco à volta da fogueira, além de uma técnica simples para fermentar picante de malagueta, perfeito para acompanhar um rosti estaladiço.

programme.title: Sabores da Ásia com Diana Chan
programme.desc: A cozinha cambojana é muitas vezes esquecida na Austrália, por isso Diana pede a ajuda do chef Jerry Mai para explorar os sabores vibrantes que a compõem.

programme.title: Sabores da Ásia com Diana Chan
programme.desc: Diana procura inspiração nas suas raízes malaias, evocando as vistas e os cheiros das bancas de comida da sua infância. Recebe ainda dois convidados para demonstrarem as suas receitas caseiras favoritas.

programme.title: Iguarias Semivegetarianas
programme.desc: As memórias gastronómicas vão muito além do que temos no prato à nossa frente. A melhor parte do dia para mim era quando nos sentávamos à mesa à hora do jantar e fazíamos a refeição em família.

programme.title: Iguarias Semivegetarianas
programme.desc: Iguarias Semivegetarianas é sobre como tornar divertido o ato de comer vegetais, e estas receitas são precisamente isso – divertidas! Cozinhar e comer é sobre partilhar bons momentos e criar memórias gastronómicas incríveis.

programme.title: Iguarias Semivegetarianas
programme.desc: Alguns alimentos têm vindo a ser designados “superalimentos”, mas se pusermos o jargão do marketing de lado, vamos perceber que, de facto, muitos ingredientes são superalimentos, como por exemplo o paté!

programme.title: Iguarias Semivegetarianas
programme.desc: À segunda-feira, já ando a sonhar acordada com o que irei cozinhar no próximo fim de semana. Adoro experimentar coisas novas com tempo, mas também algumas receitas que posso cozinhar com antecedência para ter mais tempo para os meus filhos.

programme.desc: Nesta aventura hilariante, uma sonhadora impetuosa (Amy Schumer) e a sua ultracautelosa mãe (Goldie Hawn) têm de trabalhar em equipa para sobreviver quando as suas férias sofrem uma reviravolta inesperada.

programme.title: Rapaz A
programme.desc: Jack Burridge, um assassino de crianças condenado, encontra trabalho como estafeta. Um jornal local descobre o seu passado, e Jack vê-se confrontado com a raiva e o medo dos habitantes pela segurança dos seus filhos.

programme.title: Eduardo Mãos de Tesoura
programme.desc: Eduardo é a maior criação do inventor. No entanto, a súbita morte do criador deixa Eduardo sozinho, incompleto e dotado de afiadas tesouras em vez de mãos. Mas eis que Eduardo conhece Kim, que o leva para morar em casa dela e da família.

programme.title: Acordado
programme.desc: Clay Beresford, é um jovem milionário que aparenta ter tudo - dinheiro, uma lindíssima mulher e uma carreira lucrativa - mas, o que mais precisa é de fazer o transplante de coração que poderá salvar-lhe a vida.

programme.title: Casamento Real
programme.desc: Uma casamenteira de Nova Iorque é contratada por um rei para encontrar uma noiva apropriada para o filho a tempo de uma celebração nacional.

programme.title: O Fruto Proibido
programme.desc: Halit está obcecado por Yildiz. Para pôr em marcha o seu próprio plano, Yildiz tenta aceder ao telemóvel da Ender.

programme.title: No.309 (VO)
programme.desc: Enquanto Pelinsu se prepara para o jantar de negócios com entusiasmo, Kurtulus e Samet estão procurando maneiras de provar a inocência de Onur para Lale. Em resposta ao esquema de Pelinsu, Filiz e Lale cooperam.

programme.title: Amor eterno
programme.desc: Nihan conta a Leyla que Emir a ameaçou. Vildan decide provar ao filho que tem boas intenções. Kemal vai atrás dos homens de Emir.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador (VO)
programme.desc: Can sequestra Sanem para evitar que vá a casa de Yigit e leva-a para uma cabana.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador (VO)
programme.desc: Can sequestra Sanem para evitar que vá a casa de Yigit e leva-a para uma cabana.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador (VO)
programme.desc: Produz-se uma confusão inesperada entre o JJ e a Ayhan, enquanto o Can e a Sanem tentam reformular e dar sentido à sua relação.

programme.title: ASLI entre herdeiros (VO)
programme.desc: A saída apressada de Asli e Burak da festa deixa todos à nora. Entretanto, o casal vê-se forçado a passar a noite em alto-mar, à espera de ser resgatado.

programme.title: O Meu Nome é Farah (VO)
programme.desc: Farah espera o pior quando Tahir a leva para um sítio estranho. Farah ajuda a ex-namorada de Tahir depois de uma tentativa de suicídio.

programme.title: Flores de Aço
programme.desc: Magnólias de aço é a história do salão de beleza de Truvy e do seu grupo de amigas, que vivem na mesma cidade,.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: Jamie apressa-se a chegar a Wilmington para salvar Claire da forca e descobre que a Revolução Americana já chegou à Carolina do Norte.

programme.title: Jogos do destino (VO)
programme.desc: Tugçe vai falar com Ada e ameaça-a, dizendo-lhe que já sabe de toda a verdade. Bora está muito nervoso, pois tem uma proposta a fazer a Ada. A tia Nergis fica destroçada, quando se apercebe de todas as mentiras que a Ada lhes disse.

programme.title: ASLI entre herdeiros (VO)
programme.desc: Com a desculpa de inaugurar a casa nova, Çagla prepara uma armadilha para Asli. A ex de Burak aproveita aqueles momentos a sós com Asli para a humilhar.

programme.title: O Fruto Proibido
programme.desc: Sahika sai de casa depois de cortar relações com Kaya, enquanto Ender e Yildiz executam o seu plano contra Leyla. Entre enganos e tensões familiares, as relações são redefinidas e as consequências surgem rapidamente.

programme.title: O Fruto Proibido
programme.desc: Quando Leyla decide partir, Yildiz e Ender convencem-se de que ganharam a guerra, mas tudo se complica quando ela muda de ideias. Ao mesmo tempo, Sahika, completamente descontrolada, começa um jogo novo e perigoso.

programme.title: Amor eterno
programme.desc: Kemal ainda não está convencido e Emir culpa Nihan por isso. Entretanto, Zeynep encontra-se no lugar errado, na altura errada.

programme.title: Vida de mentira
programme.desc: Quando Julia, uma mãe solteira, percebe que Olivia, a ama noturna, está a virar os seus filhos contra ela, tem de lutar para provar que Olivia não é quem diz ser, antes que ela consiga obter a guarda permanente das crianças.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador (VO)
programme.desc: Can e Sanem passam um dia incrível na montanha e não conseguem esconder o amor que sentem um pelo outro, mas recusam-se a ficar juntos.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador (VO)
programme.desc: Yigit conta a Polen que irá viajar com Sanem e ela fica contente ao pensar que, finalmente, ficará a sós com Can.

programme.title: No.309 (VO)
programme.desc: Irritada com Erol, Filiz decide ficar na casa de Lale. Embora Lale peça desculpa, Onur continua chateado e quer ter a certeza do verdadeiro arrependimento de Lale.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: Jamie apressa-se a chegar a Wilmington para salvar Claire da forca e descobre que a Revolução Americana já chegou à Carolina do Norte.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: Claire descobre que Mandy, a filha recém-nascida de Roger e Brianna, tem problemas cardíacos. Esta descoberta obriga Roger e Brianna a tomarem uma decisão difícil. Uma cara conhecida regressa a Ridge.

programme.title: Romeu e Julieta
programme.desc: Em Verona Beach, a rivalidade visceral entre dois gangues leva dois jovens apaixonados, mas de lados opostos, a desafiar as famílias e a arriscar tudo pelo amor.

programme.title: A Estrada para o Céu
programme.desc: Um anjo enviado de volta à Terra para ajudar pessoas necessitadas assume o papel de conselheira escolar temporária. Trabalhando ao lado do diretor de uma escola preparatória, intervém na vida de um aluno problemático e da sua família.

programme.title: Liga de Mulheres
programme.desc: Durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial, a Liga de Basebol Profissional Feminino atingiu o auge, com a maioria dos homens mais jovens na frente de batalha a combater. Vários anos depois, as jogadoras reúnem-se e recordam os tempos em que jogavam juntas.

programme.title: O Fruto Proibido
programme.desc: Zeynep descobre a personalidade dura de Alihan, mas não deixa de se interrogar se seria possível apaixonar-se por alguém tão diferente dela.

programme.title: ASLI entre herdeiros
programme.desc: A estadia de Asli e Burak em Datça faz com que o casal se conheça um pouco melhor, mas a bolha que criaram entre eles é quebrada quando têm de voltar para Bodrum.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: Uma epidemia de desinteria propaga-se em Ridge e Claire fica extremamente doente. Está quase recuperada quando os Christy chegam e dão uma notícia avassaladora aos Fraser. Com rumores nefastos a propagarem-se rapidamente em Ridge, dá-se uma tragédia.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: Claire luta com os seus demónios enquanto um rumor nefasto se propaga por Ridge. A tensão aumenta porque os residentes receiam que uma pessoa perigosa esteja a viver entre eles.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: Richard Brown e a sua Comissão de Segurança chegam para prender Claire por homicídio. Depois de uma luta, Jamie e Claire aceitam as exigências de Richard e vão de livre vontade.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: Jamie apressa-se a chegar a Wilmington para salvar Claire da forca e descobre que a Revolução Americana já chegou à Carolina do Norte.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: Claire descobre que Mandy, a filha recém-nascida de Roger e Brianna, tem problemas cardíacos. Esta descoberta obriga Roger e Brianna a tomarem uma decisão difícil. Uma cara conhecida regressa a Ridge.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Peter Pan cresceu e é, agora, um advogado voraz, casado com a neta de Wendy. Quando Gancho rapta os filhos de Peter, ele vê-se obrigado a voltar à Terra do Nunca. Com a ajuda de Sininho e dos Meninos Perdidos, Peter Pan volta a defrontar o Capitão Gancho.

programme.title: O Meu Primeiro Beijo
programme.desc: Uma história irresistível sobre o primeiro amor e a primeira perca. Vada é uma menina rebelde que vive com o pai, viúvo e dono da agência funerária local. Thomas, o seu melhor amigo, é alérgico a quase tudo, e acompanha Vada em todas as aventuras.

programme.title: Uma Nova Esperança
programme.desc: Birdee Pruitt tem uma vida que a maioria das pessoas invejaria. Mas quando, num «reality show», o marido traidor lhe revela que é infiel, a vida de Birdee Pruitt fica completamente estilhaçada.

programme.title: 10 Coisas Que Odeio em Ti
programme.desc: No primeiro dia de aulas, Cameron apaixona-se por Bianca. O único problema é que Bianca está proibida de sair sem a irmã Kat - uma temperamental... É então que Cameron desafia o único rapaz que poderá emparelhar com Kat - um rufia com péssima reputação.

programme.title: Lady of the Manor
programme.desc: O fantasma de uma bela dama sulista tenta ensinar boas maneiras a uma moça desleixada.

programme.title: Eduardo Mãos de Tesoura
programme.desc: Eduardo é a maior criação do inventor. No entanto, a súbita morte do criador deixa Eduardo sozinho, incompleto e dotado de afiadas tesouras em vez de mãos. Mas eis que Eduardo conhece Kim, que o leva para morar em casa dela e da família.

programme.title: Uma faísca de Natal
programme.desc: Molly ficou viúva recentemente e , com alguma relutância, aceita a tarefa de dirigir um espetáculo de Natal. Em breve, começa a apaixonar-se por Hank, o protagonista da peça e o solteiro mais cobiçado da cidade.

programme.title: Romance ao Acaso
programme.desc: A tenente Callie Jackson regressa a casa após uma missão militar e descobre que o restaurante do seu falecido avô está a atravessar dificuldades.

programme.title: Doidos por Mary
programme.desc: Apaixonado por Mary, antiga colega de liceu, o desajeitado Ted consegue localizá-la, anos mais tarde, com a ajuda de um detetive, que também se apaixona por ela. Mas ambos descobrem que todos os homens que põem os olhos em Mary ficam perdidos de amor.

programme.title: O meu Primeiro Beijo 2
programme.desc: Vada tem agora 13 anos e leva uma vida tranquila. Quando decide fazer um trabalho para a escola sobre a mãe que nunca conheceu, rapidamente percebe que não sabe nada sobre ela e parte para Los Angeles, à procura do tio, que a poderá ajudar.

programme.title: Assassinato em...
programme.desc: ASSASSINATO EM GRASSE. Um cadáver carbonizado é encontrado numa perfumaria na cidade de Grasse. Uma tatuagem no corpo da vítima conduz à lendária 13ª essência - o mítico Graal dos perfumistas - que remonta ao antigo Egipto.

programme.title: Assassinato em...
programme.desc: ASSASSINATO EM STRASBOURG. Katel Leguennec tem de investigar uma série de homicídios ligados a uma propriedade vinícola e à lenda de Santa Odília, uma jovem rapariga que nasceu cega.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador
programme.desc: Mevkibe tenta conseguir que Ayhan lhe dê informação sobre Saném. Aylin confessa a Can que continua apaixonada por Emré, apesar de ele a rejeitar.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador
programme.desc: Aysun decide dar aulas de yoga para ofuscar a festa de Mevkibe. Sánem decide confessar a Can o que sente por ele, mas ao chegar a sua casa depara com uma surpresa inesperada.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador
programme.desc: Sanem fica muito nervosa ao conhecer Polen e decide sair de casa de Can, mas ela convence-a a ficar. Nihat e Muzaffer decidem visitar Osman, já que ambos perderam as suas lojas.

programme.title: No.309
programme.desc: Pelinsu não tolera a presença da Lale na empresa. Lale e Onur procuram maneiras de resolver a tensão entre as suas famílias, e Haluk ajuda-os. Como será que irão todos reagir ao plano?

programme.title: No.309
programme.desc: Todos começam a acreditar no jogo de Lale e Onur. Pelinsu está feliz com a separação dos dois. Por outro lado, Yildiz e Songül lamentam-na profundamente.

programme.title: No.309
programme.desc: Sebnem tenta aproximar-se de Haluk. O plano de Lale e Onur está a correr às mil maravilhas, e a Sra. Èlsmet junta-se ao jogo contra Yildiz e Songül. Lale apanha uma infeção no hospital e adoece. Será que ela e o bebé correm perigo de vida?

programme.title: Casamento Real
programme.desc: Uma casamenteira de Nova Iorque é contratada por um rei para encontrar uma noiva apropriada para o filho a tempo de uma celebração nacional.

programme.title: Romeu + Julieta
programme.desc: Nesta adaptação de Baz Luhrmann, a clássica história de amor de William Shakespeare passa do tempo da Idade Média para a futurista cidade de Verona Beach. Aí, Romeu e Julieta apaixonam-se e vivem o amor de uma vida.

programme.title: A Estrada para o Céu
programme.desc: Um anjo enviado de volta à Terra para ajudar pessoas necessitadas assume o papel de conselheira escolar temporária. Trabalhando ao lado do diretor de uma escola preparatória, intervém na vida de um aluno problemático e da sua família.

programme.title: De Repente, já nos 30!
programme.desc: Uma adolescente pede um desejo no dia em que faz 13 anos e acorda, no dia seguinte, no corpo de uma mulher de 30 anos.

programme.title: Long Weekend
programme.desc: Um escritor que atravessa uma má fase conhece uma mulher enigmática que entra na sua vida mesmo na hora certa...

programme.title: O Legado do Véu Encantado
programme.desc: Na terceira parte da trilogia, Tracy é a última das três amigas a ficar com o véu de noiva antigo. Será que ele também terá um efeito mágico nela, apesar do seu ceticismo?

programme.title: Uma Canção de Amor
programme.desc: Num parque de campismo de uma zona rural, uma mulher aguarda sozinha e ansiosa a chegada de um amor do passado. Viúvos, Faye e Lito não se viam há décadas e passam horas a conversar sobre as suas vidas, amores e perdas.

programme.title: Amigos Coloridos
programme.desc: Dylan e Jamie pensam que vai ser fácil manter a amizade, mesmo adicionando um ingrediente extra: sexo. No entanto, rapidamente descobrem que uma relação física traz sempre complicações...

programme.title: Julie e Julia
programme.desc: Julie Powell sente-se estagnada. E parte à aventura! Durante 365 dias, Julie cozinha as 524 receitas do livro de Julia Child - a mulher que, no final dos anos 40, mudou para sempre o modo de cozinhar na América. E ainda relata as experiências num blogue...

programme.title: Galicia Enxebre Com David Arcay T2
programme.desc: El rio Eume es uno de los rios mas bonitos de Galicia sobre todo en la zona de la desembocadura, Este rio no se considera de montaña por su proximidad al mar pero no por eso es menos espectacular.

programme.title: Adiestrando Para La Caza
programme.desc: Último caítulo de esta segunda temporada. Conoceremos en qué consiste una prueba de SanHuberto y cómo afrontarla para tener éxito en ella.

programme.title: Súper Mario Boss
programme.desc: Argentina es el pais del asado por excelencia. Mario aprovecha la caza de distintas especies para asarlas al estilo argentino, maestros de la parrilla.

programme.title: Play Pesca
programme.desc: Es andaluza, gran aficionada al carpfishing y pescadora en pareja. Hoy Susana Lara, también conocida como Lady Carpfishing, visita nuestro podcast con la caña y hablará con Odei Jainaga sobre su gran afición con la caña.

programme.title: Carpfishing Exótico na Andaluzía
programme.desc: Conhecido como o lago da Andaluzia, Iznajar é a maior albufeira desta comunidade e a pesca nestas águas é um desafio para qualquer pescador devido à diversidade das suas zonas de pesca, uma vez que se trata de uma albufeira com muitos locais diferentes.

programme.title: Boreale, Vivências de Um Guia de Caça
programme.desc: Aprovechando el viaje con un grupo de cazadores españoles para cazar chanchos y antílope negro, Jordi nos revelará una de sus pasiones menos conocida: la caza de acuáticas. ¡Y qué mejor que Argentina para descubrir si es diestro o no con la escopeta.

programme.title: Adiestrando Para La Caza
programme.desc: Ante un ruido desconocido nuestros perros pueden asustarse e incluso quedase inmovilizados. En este capítulo abordamos una tarea clave: educar al perro a los ruidos mediante la sociabilización y la pasión por la caza.

programme.title: Cozinha Selvagem Com Diego Gallegos
programme.desc: Embarcados con un barco atunero de Tarifa, Diego conoce la técnica de pesca que utilizan al vivo para capturar los atunes rojos. Además, veremos como se “ronquea” un atún de gran tamaño. En su restaurante, Diego nos muestra un par de recetas de atún rojo.

programme.title: O Neira, Uma Tarde de Julho
programme.desc: Com a mão de Alex Puente, iniciamos esta viagem pelas águas do rio Neira, no sul da província de Lugo. Iremos pescar neste ambiente, no meio da natureza, com a intenção de fazê-lo com mosca seca.

programme.title: Lances Monteros En La Tierra Portuguesa
programme.desc: En la comarca de Tras os montes se celebra una monteria entre amigos con el jabalí como pincipal protagonista.

programme.title: A Muestra Con El 28
programme.desc: Nacho Olave y Aitor Iraola son dos apasionados cazadores con perro de muestra que tienen una particularidad en su forma de cazar, la de usar un calibre muy deportivo como es el 28. Becadas y codornices pondrán a prueba tanto sus escopetas del 28 como las líneas de setter que ellos mismos crían.

programme.title: Con Arco Al Límite
programme.desc: Intentamos cazar conejos con arco tradicional, enfrentándonos a animales rápidos, lances inesperados y oportunidades que duran apenas unos segundos. Una modalidad donde los reflejos y la precisión son fundamentales. Aquí no hay margen para la improvisación, solo técnica e instinto.

programme.title: Pescando Com a Enchufáve
programme.desc: Dia de treino de inverno em Almenara aplicando lições de campeões: isco massivo de fundo com bolinhas de engodo e controlo exaustivo da cala.

programme.title: Adiestrando Para La Caza
programme.desc: Ante un ruido desconocido nuestros perros pueden asustarse e incluso quedase inmovilizados. En este capítulo abordamos una tarea clave: educar al perro a los ruidos mediante la sociabilización y la pasión por la caza.

programme.title: Adiestrando Para La Caza
programme.desc: Último caítulo de esta segunda temporada. Conoceremos en qué consiste una prueba de SanHuberto y cómo afrontarla para tener éxito en ella.

programme.title: Galicia Enxebre Com David Arcay T2
programme.desc: El rio Eume es uno de los rios mas bonitos de Galicia sobre todo en la zona de la desembocadura, Este rio no se considera de montaña por su proximidad al mar pero no por eso es menos espectacular.

programme.title: Con Arco Al Límite
programme.desc: Nos ponemos a prueba en un campo de tiro al plato, entrenando con arco tradicional y preparando la técnica para los desafíos que nos esperan en el campo. Entre platos en movimiento, errores y aciertos, buscamos mejorar nuestros reflejos, coordinación y precisión.

programme.title: De Viagem: Sal, a Ilha dos Mil Peixes
programme.desc: Uma equipa do canal Caça e Pesca viaja até à ilha do Sal, no arquipélago macaronésico de Cabo Verde. Uma ilha praticamente plana dedicada durante anos à extração do sal e que hoje é um destino turístico com praias maravilhosas de areia branca, águas quentes e cristalinas com recifes de coral.

programme.title: Play Pesca
programme.desc: Es andaluza, gran aficionada al carpfishing y pescadora en pareja. Hoy Susana Lara, también conocida como Lady Carpfishing, visita nuestro podcast con la caña y hablará con Odei Jainaga sobre su gran afición con la caña.

programme.title: Caçadores de Javalis T6
programme.desc: Cerca de Astorga en el occidente de la provincia de León se encuentra un pequeño municipio de nombre Pradorrey.

programme.title: Românticos do Torcaz
programme.desc: Os caçadores basco navarros são, na sua maioria, adeptos da caça ao pombo torcaz. Começando com as passagens tradicionais, estes caçadores vivem esta caça de forma apaixonado, uma paixão que passa de pais para filhos desde tempos imemoriais.

programme.title: Lances no Rio Ara
programme.desc: Aratz e Denís são membros da equipa de lançamento e pesca à mosca do País Basco. No verão, os rios no País Basco secam e Torla ou Bujaruelo oferecem-lhes paisagens e trutas que os mantém completamente apaixonados pelo lugar.

programme.title: Con Arco Al Límite
programme.desc: Intentamos cazar conejos con arco tradicional, enfrentándonos a animales rápidos, lances inesperados y oportunidades que duran apenas unos segundos. Una modalidad donde los reflejos y la precisión son fundamentales. Aquí no hay margen para la improvisación, solo técnica e instinto.

programme.title: O Neira, Uma Tarde de Julho
programme.desc: Com a mão de Alex Puente, iniciamos esta viagem pelas águas do rio Neira, no sul da província de Lugo. Iremos pescar neste ambiente, no meio da natureza, com a intenção de fazê-lo com mosca seca.

programme.title: Quebec com Visão de Pássaro
programme.desc: José Boily es un entusiasta cazador y pescador canadiense de la provincia de Quebec que ha diseñado y protagonizado una serie de caza y de pesca que triunfa en Canadá y Francia en los últimos años. Probablemente la manera de cazar en la provincia de Quebec es la más similar a las técnicas europeas.

programme.title: Carnaza
programme.desc: Último capítulo de la temporada con la visita de un amigo, Enrique Martín, creador de contenido en redes sociales, al que nuestro chef le tiene preparada la receta más premium.

programme.title: Única Oportunidad
programme.desc: En los alpes franceses y aprovechando las pistas de la estación de esqui de Vercors, Antonio rececha la gamuza alpina, como siempre con la ayuda de su rifle monotiro.

programme.title: O Pantanal, Refúgio da Onça-Pintada
programme.desc: A onça-pintada, também conhecida como otorongo ou onça-pantera, é o maior felino e o de maior distribuição nas Américas. Embora não esteja em grave perigo de extinção, sua situação é delicada.

programme.title: Lúcios em Madrid
programme.desc: José Manuel e Javi, dois apaixonados pescadores de predadores, convidam-nos a conhecer a pesca de Lucios em um dos reservatórios da serra de Madrid, onde a pesca destes vorazes peixes faz deliciar muitos dos pescadores da capital madrilena.

programme.title: Lances Monteros En La Tierra Portuguesa
programme.desc: En la comarca de Tras os montes se celebra una monteria entre amigos con el jabalí como pincipal protagonista.

programme.title: Súper Mario Boss
programme.desc: Argentina es el pais del asado por excelencia. Mario aprovecha la caza de distintas especies para asarlas al estilo argentino, maestros de la parrilla.

programme.title: Pescando Com a Enchufáve
programme.desc: Estreia oficial na modalidade de pesca à enchufável com cana MAP de 11 metros. A jornada começa com o característico bom ambiente e café entre amigos antes de um concurso social em Almenara.

programme.title: Twins Fish
programme.desc: Amanda y Emily comienzan sus aventuras en Key West, en los Cayos de Florida. Allí se lanzan a la búsqueda de grandes ejemplares de dorado (mahi-mahi) y practican apnea para capturar langostas en las cristalinas aguas de la región.

programme.title: Mar de Tinta
programme.desc: David mostra-nos a sua terra como só um amante do mar poderia fazê-lo. A sua paixão pela pesca submarina entrelaça-se com a descoberta de uma antiga técnica japonesa: o gyotaku, ou “impressão de peixes”.

programme.title: A Muestra Con El 28
programme.desc: Nacho Olave y Aitor Iraola son dos apasionados cazadores con perro de muestra que tienen una particularidad en su forma de cazar, la de usar un calibre muy deportivo como es el 28. Becadas y codornices pondrán a prueba tanto sus escopetas del 28 como las líneas de setter que ellos mismos crían.

programme.title: Así Somos: One Health, Una Sola Salud
programme.desc: La salud de los seres humanos, los animales y la naturaleza forman un equilibrio único e inseparable. Esa es la premisa de la que parte el movimiento “One Health, Una Sola Salud”. A lo largo de este documental nos adentraremos en este enfoque global donde los cazadores juegan un papel clave.

programme.desc: Embarcados con un barco atunero de Tarifa, Diego conoce la técnica de pesca que utilizan al vivo para capturar los atunes rojos. Además, veremos como se “ronquea” un atún de gran tamaño. En su restaurante, Diego nos muestra un par de recetas de atún rojo.

programme.title: Carpfishing Exótico na Andaluzía
programme.desc: Conhecido como o lago da Andaluzia, Iznajar é a maior albufeira desta comunidade e a pesca nestas águas é um desafio para qualquer pescador devido à diversidade das suas zonas de pesca, uma vez que se trata de uma albufeira com muitos locais diferentes.

programme.title: Boreale, Vivências de Um Guia de Caça
programme.desc: Aprovechando el viaje con un grupo de cazadores españoles para cazar chanchos y antílope negro, Jordi nos revelará una de sus pasiones menos conocida: la caza de acuáticas. ¡Y qué mejor que Argentina para descubrir si es diestro o no con la escopeta.

programme.title: O Pescador Submarino Sustentável
programme.desc: Criado na ligação à natureza, embarcamos com David Foncueva numa viagem submarina pelo Cantábrico, onde a qualidade da pesca está acima da quantidade. O mar, a pesca e o respeito pelo ambiente são a nossa bandeira. Desfrutar e levar peixe fresco para casa é o objetivo desta aventura submarina.

programme.title: Twins Fish
programme.desc: Las gemelas emprenden una travesía de cientos de millas por mar abierto rumbo a las Bahamas. Una vez allí, disfrutan de las aguas tropicales de West End y se dedican a la pesca de fondo en busca de especies que habitan en las profundidades.

programme.title: Caçadores de Javalis T6
programme.desc: La pasión por el jabalí es también pasión por el perro y por las armas usadas en su caza. Allá donde haya jabalíes habrá cazadores volcados casi en exclusiva a esta especie, especializándose del mismo modo en razas de perros y en equipos adecuados.

programme.title: Trutas da Montanha em Cauterets
programme.desc: Aratz Zuazo continua a sua busca pelos melhores locais nos Pirenéus para a pesca de trutas. Depois da sua viagem anterior a Torla e Bujaruelo, desta vez viaja para Cauterets, em França.

programme.title: Caçadores de Javalis T6
programme.desc: Cerca de Astorga en el occidente de la provincia de León se encuentra un pequeño municipio de nombre Pradorrey.

programme.title: Galicia Enxebre Com David Arcay T2
programme.desc: El rio Navea es sin duda no de los rios de montaña que mayor concentracion de peces grandes que puede tener en Galicia. Pescaremos la parte mas alta donde los peces tiene algo menos de tamaño y en la parte baja de la montaña buscaremos las truchas trofeo.

programme.title: Lances no Rio Ara
programme.desc: Aratz e Denís são membros da equipa de lançamento e pesca à mosca do País Basco. No verão, os rios no País Basco secam e Torla ou Bujaruelo oferecem-lhes paisagens e trutas que os mantém completamente apaixonados pelo lugar.

programme.title: Play Pesca
programme.desc: Es andaluza, gran aficionada al carpfishing y pescadora en pareja. Hoy Susana Lara, también conocida como Lady Carpfishing, visita nuestro podcast con la caña y hablará con Odei Jainaga sobre su gran afición con la caña.

programme.title: Quebec com Visão de Pássaro
programme.desc: José Boily es un entusiasta cazador y pescador canadiense de la provincia de Quebec que ha diseñado y protagonizado una serie de caza y de pesca que triunfa en Canadá y Francia en los últimos años. Probablemente la manera de cazar en la provincia de Quebec es la más similar a las técnicas europeas.

programme.title: Carnaza
programme.desc: Último capítulo de la temporada con la visita de un amigo, Enrique Martín, creador de contenido en redes sociales, al que nuestro chef le tiene preparada la receta más premium.

programme.title: Pescando Com a Enchufáve
programme.desc: Estreia oficial na modalidade de pesca à enchufável com cana MAP de 11 metros. A jornada começa com o característico bom ambiente e café entre amigos antes de um concurso social em Almenara.

programme.title: Única Oportunidad
programme.desc: En los alpes franceses y aprovechando las pistas de la estación de esqui de Vercors, Antonio rececha la gamuza alpina, como siempre con la ayuda de su rifle monotiro.

programme.title: O Pantanal, Refúgio da Onça-Pintada
programme.desc: A onça-pintada, também conhecida como otorongo ou onça-pantera, é o maior felino e o de maior distribuição nas Américas. Embora não esteja em grave perigo de extinção, sua situação é delicada.

programme.title: Lúcios em Madrid
programme.desc: José Manuel e Javi, dois apaixonados pescadores de predadores, convidam-nos a conhecer a pesca de Lucios em um dos reservatórios da serra de Madrid, onde a pesca destes vorazes peixes faz deliciar muitos dos pescadores da capital madrilena.

programme.title: Súper Mario Boss
programme.desc: Argentina es el pais del asado por excelencia. Mario aprovecha la caza de distintas especies para asarlas al estilo argentino, maestros de la parrilla.

programme.title: A Muestra Con El 28
programme.desc: Nacho Olave y Aitor Iraola son dos apasionados cazadores con perro de muestra que tienen una particularidad en su forma de cazar, la de usar un calibre muy deportivo como es el 28. Becadas y codornices pondrán a prueba tanto sus escopetas del 28 como las líneas de setter que ellos mismos crían.

programme.title: Súper Mario Boss
programme.desc: Mario viaja hasta uno de los desiertos más secos del mundo, Atacama. Allí intentará cazar guanacos y vicuñas con las que elaborar excelentes recetas con su exquisita carne.

programme.title: O Pantanal, Domínio da Onça Pintada Ii
programme.desc: Juntamente com o nosso naturalista Manuel Fernández, iremos aprofundar a vida deste felino. Para tal, ficaremos alojados numa quinta de onde partem barcos que oferecem a oportunidade de avistar a esquiva onça-pintada.

programme.title: Trutas da Montanha em Cauterets
programme.desc: Aratz Zuazo continua a sua busca pelos melhores locais nos Pirenéus para a pesca de trutas. Depois da sua viagem anterior a Torla e Bujaruelo, desta vez viaja para Cauterets, em França.

programme.title: Lances Monteros En La Tierra Portuguesa
programme.desc: La sierra de Lousa ostenta el actual record de venado portugues y alberga una gran densidad de reses que causan daños en la agricultura. Para paliar los daños, 150 monteros se citaron en Alvares con un cupo de 10 reses por cazador.

programme.title: Carpfishing Exótico na Andaluzía
programme.desc: Encinarejo é uma das barragens mais bonitas desta comunidade, regada pelo rio Jándula, esta barragem de águas cristalinas é conhecida por ter as carpas mais explosivas e fortes da Andaluzia.

programme.title: Quebec com Visão de Pássaro
programme.desc: José Boily es un entusiasta cazador y pescador canadiense de la provincia de Quebec que ha diseñado y protagonizado una serie de caza y de pesca que triunfa en Canadá y Francia en los últimos años. Probablemente la manera de cazar en la provincia de Quebec es la más similar a las técnicas europeas.

programme.title: Boreale, Vivências de Um Guia de Caça
programme.desc: Seguramente, sean cuales sean los episodios venideros de Boreale, este será el más excéntrico de todos. Nos vamos a la costa alicantina… ¡a por un atún! ¿Será capaz nuestro protagonista de luchar con un bluefin de más de 300 kg.

programme.title: Play Pesca
programme.desc: Es andaluza, gran aficionada al carpfishing y pescadora en pareja. Hoy Susana Lara, también conocida como Lady Carpfishing, visita nuestro podcast con la caña y hablará con Odei Jainaga sobre su gran afición con la caña.

programme.title: Lances Monteros En La Tierra Portuguesa
programme.desc: En la comarca de Tras os montes se celebra una monteria entre amigos con el jabalí como pincipal protagonista.

programme.title: Pescando Com a Enchufáve
programme.desc: Dia de treino de inverno em Almenara aplicando lições de campeões: isco massivo de fundo com bolinhas de engodo e controlo exaustivo da cala.

programme.title: Românticos do Torcaz
programme.desc: Os caçadores basco navarros são, na sua maioria, adeptos da caça ao pombo torcaz. Começando com as passagens tradicionais, estes caçadores vivem esta caça de forma apaixonado, uma paixão que passa de pais para filhos desde tempos imemoriais.

programme.title: Así Somos: One Health, Una Sola Salud
programme.desc: La salud de los seres humanos, los animales y la naturaleza forman un equilibrio único e inseparable. Esa es la premisa de la que parte el movimiento “One Health, Una Sola Salud”. A lo largo de este documental nos adentraremos en este enfoque global donde los cazadores juegan un papel clave.

programme.title: Única Oportunidad
programme.desc: Antonio Adán se embarca para cazar con su escopeta monotiro distintas especies de aves marinas. Una modalidad tradicional islandesa.

programme.title: A Muestra Con El 28
programme.desc: Nacho Olave y Aitor Iraola son dos apasionados cazadores con perro de muestra que tienen una particularidad en su forma de cazar, la de usar un calibre muy deportivo como es el 28.
